newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador posts $9 mln trade deficit in January.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador posts $9 mln trade deficit in January.

text.p: Ecuador reported a trade deficit of $9 million for January 1997, versus a $15 million surplus in the same month last year, the Central Bank said on Thursday.
Exports reached $371 million, up from the $362 million in January 1996. Imports grew to $380 million from $347 million.
Ecuador reported a trade surplus of $1.37 billion for 1996, up from a $354 million surplus in 1995, according to official figures.
